content: 'Inɨari niukiyari kwiniyate waiyaritsie mieme
Yawé Muitsexi meta 'Aruni mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe:

«Xɨka xewitɨ xeme yunawiyaritsie heuhaka xetatɨ kumariketɨ yatɨni tuxatɨ heukumanetɨ 'anutiteketɨ haiya kwiniyayari 'ayanike, mɨkɨ 'Aruni mawari wewiwame mepɨ'atɨirieni, yatɨni mawari wewiwamete 'iparewiwamete.

Mɨkɨ mawari wewiwame wahaiya pɨtixeiyaxɨani. Xɨka haiyatsie meuka'u huxariteya tuxani yatɨni maukumane waɨkawa heukukunini waiyarieyatsie, mɨkɨ haiya kwiniyayari pɨhɨkɨ. Mɨkɨ tewi kwiniyaya tixeiyaxɨame, 'anari mawari wewiwame pɨtitaxatɨani kename ka'itiyatɨ 'ayani.
»Tuxatɨ meukumane xɨka kaheukukunini waiyarieyatsie meta huxariteya katuxani, mawari wewiwame mɨtikuye yuxaɨtame pupata 'atahuta tukari,
'atahuta tukari 'aye'ayu hekwamekɨta pixeiya, xɨka yaxeikɨa reu'atɨkani kayemieni nawiyarieyatsie tawarita 'atahuta tukari puyurieni tikwikame.

'Atahuta tukari 'aye'atɨarieyu mawari wewiwame tawarita pixeiya hutarieka, xɨkari kwiniya kayemieni waiyarieyatsie yatɨni yeyuximeni, 'anari yapɨtayɨni mɨ'itiyakɨ. Mɨkɨ haiya xetatɨ mukumarike xeikɨa pɨhɨkɨtɨkai, 'anari tewi kani'itiyamɨkɨ mɨtikuye meta yu'ixuriki kaniti'ekwamɨkɨ.
»Xɨka yaxeikɨa heu'aneni haiyaya yemieni nawiyarieyatsie, mawari wewiwame 'ixeiyakutɨtɨ para mɨ'itiyanikɨ, tikwikame tawarita mawari wewiwame hetsɨa pumie mixeiyakɨ.
Mawari wewiwame kanixeiyamɨkɨ mɨkɨ xɨka haiyaya yemieni waiyarieyatsie, mɨkɨ tewi mɨpaɨ pɨtitahɨawarieni haiya kwiniyayari mɨhɨkɨkɨ.
'Inɨari niukiyarite kwiniya haiya mɨkayu'uayemarinɨa
»Kepauka tewi haiya mexeiya yunawiyaritsie, mɨkɨ kaneuyeweka manuwitɨkienikɨ mawari wewiwame hɨxie,
tawarita pixeiya. Xɨka haiyaya meta huxariteya tuxani, meta meukuhatɨkatsie waiyarieya xɨka 'ayeniereni yuhekɨaka,
mɨkɨri haiya meripaitɨ mɨmieme pɨhɨkɨ. Mawari wewiwame mɨkɨ tewi pɨtahekɨata mɨka'itiya mayanikɨ. Matsi mɨkɨ tewi pɨkaheuyewetse hutarieka mɨpatsienikɨ yeuta, mɨmatsiɨkɨkɨri mɨka'itiyakɨ.
»Xɨka haiya yemietɨ tikwikame waiyarieyatsie heinɨka, hakewa xeikɨa mawari wewiwame mɨyɨwe mixeiyakɨ,
merikɨte mawari wewiwame pixeiya. Xɨkari naitɨ waiyarieyatsie 'inɨka, mɨkɨ yapɨtayɨni kenameri 'itiya. Mɨkɨ tewi pɨ'itiya naitɨri yuwaiyaritsie mutaturixɨkɨ.
Mɨkɨtsɨ matsi ka'itiyatɨ kanayeimɨkɨ xɨka yapauka 'ukayaxe haiya 'amɨnene.
Kepauka mawari wewiwame mita'ixɨarieni waiyarieyatsie mɨkɨ pitahekɨata kename ka'itiya. Waiyarieya mɨka'itiyakɨ, haiya kwiniyayari kanihɨkɨtɨni.
Xɨka haiyaya 'amɨnene tuxatɨ 'ayani, mɨkɨ tewi mɨtikuye kaniyemieni mawari wewiwame hetsɨa.
Mɨkɨ pixeiya xɨka haiya kayaxikeni tuxatɨ, mawari wewiwame mɨkɨ tewi pɨtahekɨata mɨ'itiya pɨhɨkɨtɨni, mɨpaɨ pɨ'aneni.
'Inɨari niukiyari haiya mayemane hepaɨtsita
»Xɨka xewitɨ haiya heukayatsani yuwaiyaritsie 'anutitekeme yatɨni kwitɨwa 'anayeweni,
xɨka heimana heukateni haiya 'etsiwa tuxatɨ, haiya heukumanetɨ xetatɨ mɨkɨ mawari wewiwame hetsɨa puyutaxata.
Mɨkɨ mixeiyakɨ. Xɨka haiyaya tetɨatapaitɨ yemieni waiyarieyatsie meta huxariteya 'utiture, mawari wewiwame pitahekɨata mɨka'itiyakɨ. Haiya kwiniyayari kanihɨkɨtɨni meukutekixɨakɨ 'axeikɨa heukatetɨ.

Matsi kepauka mawari wewiwame tikwikame mɨta'ixɨarienitsie, xɨka huxariteya katitureme 'uxeiya meta haiyaya manutiteke tetɨata kaheuneikatɨ waiyarieyatsie heukateni, meta xɨka yeyuximeni, mɨkɨ 'ateewa pɨpatsieni yuxaɨtame 'atahuta tukari.
Xɨkari haiyaya manutiteke yeyaxikeni waiyarieyatsie paitɨ tikwikame pɨtahekɨata mɨka'itiyakɨ, haiya kwiniyayari mɨhɨkɨkɨ.
Xɨkari mɨkɨ haiyaya manutiteke kayeyaxikeni meta kakutureni, xɨka xeikɨa huyeriyari yuhekɨaka, tikwikame pɨtahekɨata kename 'itiya.
'Inɨari niukiyari mukwaxe hepaɨtsita
»Xɨka xewitɨ 'ukwaxe, hakewa metakwaxixɨtsie xɨka tuxatɨ yatɨni xetatɨ haneni,

mɨkɨ mawari wewiwame pixeiya, xɨka mamarixɨtsie huxariteya tuxani, xɨka waiyarieyatsie waɨkawa heukukunini, mɨkɨ haiya kwiniyayari kanihɨkɨtɨni haiya mukwaxixɨtsie mane. Mawari wewiwame tikwikame pɨtahekɨata mɨka'itiyakɨ, haiya kwiniyayari mɨhɨkɨkɨ.

»Matsi xɨka mawari wewiwame mukwaxixɨ xeiyayu xɨka 'ikaxeiya huxariteya katuxame meukumanetsie meta waɨkawa xɨka waiyarieyatsie paitɨ kaheukukunini, meta xɨka hanukanuaximeni, 'ana mɨkɨ tikwikame 'atahuta tukari yuxaɨtame putuiyamie yateewa paitɨ.
'Atahuta tukari 'aye'ayu mawari wewiwame tawarita pixeiya, xɨka naitsarie 'inɨka waiyarieyatsie mɨkɨ yapɨtayɨni kename ka'itiya, haiya kwiniyayari kanihɨkɨtɨni.
Matsi mɨkɨ mukuture nawiyarieyatsie xɨka kayemieni, tatsɨari mɨkɨ mutataikɨ xeikɨa hatɨ. 'Ana mawari wewiwame yapɨtitahekɨata mɨ'itiyakɨ, mɨkɨ xeikɨa mutataikɨ 'inɨariyari mɨhɨkɨkɨ.
'Inɨari niukiyari haiya hepaɨtsita mɨtikuxata ranawiyaritsie yatɨni rakɨpatsie ramɨxiyatsie
»Xɨka xewitɨ 'uki yatɨni 'ukaratsi haiya mu'uyatsie haneni yatɨni mɨxiyayatsie,

mawari wewiwame haiya kanixeiyamɨkɨ. Xɨka waiyarieyatsiepai waɨkawa heukukunini, meta kɨpaya tataxawini 'etsipepetɨ, mɨkɨ tikwikame pɨtahekɨata kename ka'itiya. Mɨkɨ haiya xetatɨ mukumarike kanihɨkɨtɨni haiya mu'utsie yatɨni 'ayekwaitsie mieme.
Xɨka mawari wewiwame 'etsa xeiyayu, waɨkawa waiyarieyatsie kaheunetɨkani meta kɨpateya kayɨyɨwini, mɨkɨ mɨtikuye haiya xetatɨ mukumarike mexeiya 'ateewa paitɨ pupatsieni yuxaɨtame 'atahuta tukari.
Hikɨ 'atahuta tukari 'aye'ayu mawari wewiwame tawarita tikwikame kanixeiyamɨkɨ, xɨka haiya xetatɨ mukumarike kayemieni meta kɨpateya katataxawini, meta waɨkawa kaheukukunini waiyarieyatsie.
Hikɨ 'anari tikwikame panuyuyexini, mahatsie 'ihayewatɨ, hikɨ mawari wewiwame tawari xaɨtsie pipata yuxaɨtame 'atahuta tukari.

Tawarita 'atahuta tukari 'aye'ayu mawari wewiwame tikwikame kanixeiyamɨkɨ. Xɨkari haiya xetatɨ mukumarike 'anukanuaximeni waiyarieyatsie meta waɨkawa kaheukukunini, yapɨtitahekɨata kenameri 'itiya. Hikɨ tikwikame yu'ixurikite kaniti'ekwamɨkɨ 'anari 'itiyatɨ kanayeimɨkɨ.
»Xɨkari haiya xetatɨ mukumarikekɨ 'u'itiyakaitɨni hutariekata 'i'axiyani naitɨri waiyarieya nɨka,
mawari wewiwame pixeiya. Xɨka haiya xetatɨ mukumarike yemieni naitɨ waiyarieyatsie paitɨ, pɨkaheuyewetseri mawari wewiwame kɨpa mɨtataxawi mɨwaunenikɨ, mɨkɨ tikwikameri pɨka'itiya.
Matsi xɨka mɨkɨ haiya xetatɨ mukumarike kayemieni metatsiere kɨpateya yɨyɨwitɨ kayɨyɨrani, tatsɨari mɨtikuyekai 'anayeweka. Pɨ'itiyari, mawari wewiwame mɨpaɨ katinitahekɨatamɨkɨ.
Kuraruxiya waiyaritsie kwiniyayari
»Xɨka 'uki meta 'ukaratsi tuxatɨ kumariketɨ kuneikani waiyaritsie,
mɨkɨ mawari wewiwame pixeiya. Xɨka maukumane kutuxareni, mɨkɨ waiyarieyatsie manutinexɨa xeikɨa kanihɨkɨtɨni, mɨkɨ tewi pɨ'itiya.
Kememɨtekahukeni yumu'utsie niukiyari
»Xɨka xewitɨ yukatutsitɨa hahune, hametsetɨ yuhayewa, mɨkɨ pɨ'itiya.
Mexɨka yukanatsie 'akahune kanametsetɨ yuhayewa yaxeikɨatatsiere mɨkɨ pɨ'itiya.
Matsi xɨka yukatutsitɨa meta yukanatsie mametsetsie haiya xetatɨ haneni, mɨkɨ haiya mametsetsie mane pɨhɨkɨ.
Mawari wewiwame pixeiya. Xɨka haiyaya xetani, yuwaiyaritsie meuhaka hepaɨ 'aneneni,
kamɨtsɨ mɨkɨ tewi haiya kwiniyayarikɨ pɨtikuye pɨka'itiya. Mawari wewiwame pitahekɨata kename ka'itiya yumu'utsie haiya mayetsakɨ.
Haiya hepaɨtsita niukiyari
»Xɨka xewitɨ tewi haiya hexeiyani, mɨkɨ tsanimekɨ pɨyukemaritɨaka, pɨkayukatsikeni yuhɨxie panuyuka'eimani. Pɨyemie 'utahiwatɨ mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: “Nepɨka'itiya, nepɨka'itiya”,
mɨkɨ kemɨreutere tikuyetɨ pɨka'itiyaka. Mɨkɨ mematiteitsie yuxaɨtame 'ateewa pukani.
'Inɨari niukiyarite mutuxariya hepaɨtsita
»Kepauka kwiemuxa 'ixurikiyari yatɨni rinu 'ixurikiyaritsie waɨkawa mɨtimutuxaxɨani,
rinu 'ixurikiyari yatɨni tsepa muxa kamixayaritsie yatɨni nawitsie yatɨni mɨkɨ maye'itsetsie xɨka yuhekɨare,
xɨka 'etsiwa tsiuraɨyeni yatɨni xetani mɨkɨ mutuxariyari muwerixɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni, peuyewetse mawari wewiwame mɨxeitsitɨanikɨ,
mɨkɨ meukuwetɨka kanixeiyamɨkɨ meta 'atahuta tukari 'ateewa putuiyamie titatsie mɨtiwena.

'Atahuta tukari 'aye'ayu mawari wewiwame mawena kanixeiyamɨkɨ, xɨka mɨkɨ yemieni kamixatsie yatɨni maye'itsetsie, yatɨni nawitsie, tsepa kemɨtitita mɨkɨ mutuxariya mutiyuwiriwe kanihɨkɨtɨni. Mɨkɨ mɨya mɨ'ane pɨka'itiya.
Mɨkɨ 'iwi yatɨni maye'itse, kwiemuxa, rinu tsepa kemɨtititatsie nawitsie mɨrawena, mɨkɨ mutuxariya 'axamɨ'ane mɨhɨkɨkɨ pɨtataiyarieni.
»Matsi kepauka mawari wewiwame 'iwi mɨxeiya mutuxariya kayemieme, meta maye'itsetsie meta mi'itatɨkateitsie, meta muxa 'itariyari meta rinu tsawanayari meta tsepa kemɨtitita nawiyari,
hikɨ mɨkɨ pɨtita'aita mahauxinarienikɨ mapɨnitsie, meta tawarita 'akuxi 'atahuta tukari pɨyekani.

Xeimieme tahauxinarieyu meukupɨpɨnitsie mawari wewiwame pita'ixɨarieni. Xɨka yaxeikɨa 'aneni mukumarike kayupatani, mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ pɨtayɨni 'ixuriki ka'itiyatɨ puyuhayewa tsepa mɨka'eyewiriewe naime. Naitɨ 'ixuriki pɨtataiyarieni taɨtana meta herie.
»'Arike ti'ekwarieyu, mawari wewiwame mixeiyatsie xɨka 'ixeiya heukuwetɨkaime 'etsiwa, mɨkɨ 'ixuriki peukutsanaxɨani 'iwitsie meukuwetɨka, meta nawitsie, meta maye'itsetsie.
Xɨka hekwamekɨ heukunexɨani kemaritsie yatɨni maye'itsetsie yatɨni tsepa kemɨtitita nawitsie, tatsɨari tawari hanutineka. Mɨyama'anetsie pataiyarieni,
peru naitɨ kemarite, maye'itsetsie meta nawitsie kepauka mɨta'ekwarienitsie meukuwetɨkateitsie xɨka hayeixɨani, tawarita pɨta'ekwarieni, 'ana mɨkɨ 'itiyatɨ payani».

'Ikɨ 'inɨari niukiyari kanihɨkɨtɨni mutuxariyatsie mieme kemaritsie muweriwe, kwiemuxatsie, rinutsie, maye'itsetsie, yatɨni tsepa tita nawitsie, yamɨtitahekɨatsieninikɨ kemuti'itiya yatɨni kemɨkati'itiya.
